QUOTE: **Library code: no threads.** The index finds 4 thread spawns in this repository, and all of them are in `programs/`... The mutex type is `mbedtls_threading_mutex_t`. The lock/unlock/init/free calls are function pointers (`threading.c:101-104`) that default to pthread, and `mbedtls_threading_set_alt` (`threading.c:133`) swaps them.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says library code spawns no threads (all spawns are in programs/) and that the library supplies the mutex abstraction (mbedtls_threading_mutex_t with lock/unlock function pointers and set_alt) for threaded callers.
